rule: major counts if raised by >=2 of 4 blind reviewers (3 opus general-purpose + 1 argon); answer-4 = argon; fresh reviewers (not panel 1)
prompt:
You are a blind pixel-art reviewer. Do not read any code or other files; look ONLY at the PNG boards listed below (open each with the Read tool; look carefully, do not skip any).

Context: 16px-cell hand-pixel chipset for a JRPG dungeon, 3/4 top-down view (you see the top surface of things and their front face; NO side faces / no isometric). Theme: OTHERWORLD (demon realm, violet-black floating islands over a void). Each board shows: the item description (yellow line at top), Beodeul reference images from the existing chipset that set the quality bar (shown 1x and 3x) with an Actor1 person for scale, then one anonymous candidate (X or Y): piece at 1x and 3x, the piece placed in a scene (animation frames side by side), and for autotiles extra sheets (variants, underside sample, small platform, void mosaic). There are two boards per item, one per candidate.

Criteria, judge each candidate against them:
1. Reads instantly as the described object at 1x game scale.
2. 3/4 top-down view: top surfaces visible as planes (caps, lintel, base/dais top) + front faces, no side faces, no isometric skew, perspective consistent with the Beodeul reference and the Actor1 person.
3. Style matches the Beodeul reference: material shading instead of black ink outlines, similar contrast, 4+ step material ramps, texture density and pixel cleanliness (no noise, no orphan pixels, no banding).
4. Scale vs. the person is plausible; the object sits on the floor (contact shadow/base) rather than floating.
5. Animation frames (if any): change is visible, smooth, loops, no jitter of the static parts.
6. Autotiles: no visible seams or repeating grid, edges/corners join correctly in the variants and irregular map; floating-island underside hangs only below south edges.
7. Fits its theme (demon realm) and is distinct from generic.

A MAJOR is a problem that would make you reject the piece for shipping (misreads, wrong view, broken seams, clashing style, ugly artefact clearly visible at 1x). A MINOR is a polish note.

Boards (directory /home/main/z-project/rpg-zzu-dt-fix2/qa-runs/fix2/panel-2/):
other.portal-X.png other.portal-Y.png other.void_edge-X.png other.void_edge-Y.png

Write your answer as JSON to /home/main/z-project/rpg-zzu-dt-fix2/qa-runs/fix2/panel-2/answer-<k>.json (use the Write tool) and also return the same JSON as your final message. Format:
{"items":{"<item id e.g. other.portal>":{"X":{"majors":[{"problem":"...","where":"..."}],"minors":[{"problem":"...","where":"..."}]},"Y":{...},"pick":"X"|"Y","why":"one line"}}}
Cover both items. Be specific and honest; do not invent problems, do not be polite. Do not edit anything else.
